title: Wheat Yellow Rust (Peela Rata / Haldi Rog) Control
problem: Yellow powder/stripes appearing on wheat leaves during cool, humid February-March weather, drying out leaves and reducing grain weight by up to 40%.
advisory: Inspect fields weekly. On first notice of yellow pustules, spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 litres of water per acre. Repeat after 10-15 days if cloudy weather continues. Avoid excessive nitrogen/urea fertilizer which aggravates fungal spread.
organic_method: Spray fermented butter milk (Khatta Chhachh) mixed with copper vessel extract (5 litres in 100 litres water) in early stages.
helpline: Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551 or PAU / ICAR advisory

title: Mustard Aphid (Sarson ka Mahu / Chepa) Management
problem: Tiny green/black insects sucking sap from flowering buds and pods, causing flower drop and stunted oilseeds.
advisory: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC (Rogor) @ 250 ml OR Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 80-100 g in 150-200 litres water per acre when 10% twigs show aphid colonies. Spray late afternoon to protect honeybee pollinators.
organic_method: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Neem Oil (1500 ppm @ 3 ml per litre) or yellow sticky traps (10 traps per acre).

title: Paddy Stem Borer (Dhaan ka Tana Chhedak Rog)
problem: Larvae boring into central shoot causing 'dead heart' in tillering stage or 'white earhead' (empty white panicles) at heading stage.
advisory: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G @ 7.5 kg/acre OR Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR (Ferterra) @ 4 kg/acre in standing water (2-3 inches) when 5% dead hearts appear.
organic_method: Install pheromone traps @ 8 traps/acre for monitoring and release egg parasitoid Trichogramma @ 20,000/acre at 30 and 45 days after transplanting.

title: Cotton Pink Bollworm (Gulabi Sundi) Control
problem: Caterpillar entering green bolls, feeding on developing seeds and staining lint, drastically reducing cotton quality and yield.
advisory: Install 5 pheromone traps per acre. If trap catch exceeds 8 moths/night for 3 consecutive nights, spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 100 g OR Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 170 ml in 150 litres water per acre.
organic_method: Pick and bury rosette flowers infested with larvae. Avoid growing ratoon cotton.

title: Drip Irrigation and Water Conservation Benefits
problem: Depleting groundwater table and high electricity/diesel pumping costs under flood irrigation.
advisory: Drip irrigation saves 40-60% irrigation water and improves fertilizer efficiency by 30-40% via fertigation. Government provides 70-80% subsidy for small/marginal farmers under Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop).
organic_method: Combine drip with organic mulching (straw/crop residue) to prevent soil moisture evaporation and weed growth.

title: Natural Farming — How to Prepare Jeevamrit Bio-Fertilizer
problem: High cost of chemical fertilizers and deteriorating soil biological health.
advisory: Jeevamrit recipe for 1 acre: In a 200-litre plastic drum, mix 10 kg fresh Desi cow dung + 10 litres Desi cow urine + 2 kg old Jaggery (gur) + 2 kg pulse flour (besan) + a handful of fertile farm soil (virgin soil from tree base). Fill with water, stir clockwise twice daily. Ready in 48-72 hours in summer (5-7 days in winter). Apply with irrigation water or filter and spray (10% solution).
organic_method: Apply twice a month to boost beneficial soil microorganisms, earthworms, and plant immunity.

title: Potato Late Blight (Aloo ka Pachheti Jhulsa) Treatment
problem: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips and white mildew on undersides during cool, foggy winter weather, destroying potato crop in days.
advisory: Preventive spray: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/litre water. If disease has started: spray systemic fungicide Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate) @ 2.5 g/litre or Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5 g/litre water. Avoid night irrigation during dense fog.
organic_method: Spray Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/litre as soil and foliar preventive application.

title: Dairy Cattle Mastitis (Thanela Rog / Hawana Rog) Prevention
problem: Udder inflammation, swollen painful teats, curdled or blood-mixed milk, causing permanent loss of milk production.
advisory: Maintain strict barn sanitation. Wash hands and teats with potassium permanganate (Lal Dawai) or iodophor solution before and after milking. Do teat dipping. Keep cattle standing for at least 30-45 minutes after milking by providing fresh feed so the teat canal can close naturally.
organic_method: Apply topical paste of Turmeric powder + Aloe vera pulp + Calcium hydroxide (Chuna) on affected udder in very early stage. Contact veterinary doctor immediately for intra-mammary antibiotics if udder is hard or hot.
